WU: 400 easy, then 6x50 drills (catch-up, fingertip drag, single arm) 15s rest. Main: 3x400 steady RPE 5-6, 30s rest. Odd reps full stroke, even reps pull buoy + paddles. CD: 200 easy. Total: 2100m. All by feel (RPE 1-10), no pace targets. Goal: aerobic swim endurance and a stable stroke under fatigue.
Steady aerobic endurance ride at 60-72% FTP. Cadence 85-95 rpm, stay relaxed, smooth pedaling. Fuel 60-80g carbs/hour if over 75 min. Goal: aerobic base, fat oxidation, durability.

3 hours of climbs and rolling hills in the Merubah area, finishing with the downhill run. A great session we did last year too. Focus: precise Israman watts. - Every climb at 82-88% FTP. Know your target W/kg before you start (FTP x 0.85 / body weight) and hold it. No spikes at the start of a climb. - Seated, cadence 70-80. Stand only on the steepest parts. - Keep pedaling on the descents. - Last 20 min: Hold The Watts at 85-90% FTP, even when the legs are heavy. Fueling: 60-80 g carbs per hour, 1 bottle per hour. Race nutrition rehearsal. Straight after the ride: Downhill Burner run.
